+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}

+struct DeviceState {
+    Triangle* triangles = nullptr;
+    val_t* areas = nullptr;
+    val_t* rho = nullptr;
+    val_t* kij = nullptr;
+    int* tau = nullptr;
+    val_t* radB = nullptr;
+    val_t* distances = nullptr;
+    FlatOctreeNode* octreeNodes = nullptr;
+    idx_t* leafTriangleIndices = nullptr;
+    int octreeNodeCount = 0;
+    size_t numTriangles = 0;
+    size_t numTimesteps = 0;
+
+    void release() {
+        cudaFree(triangles);
+        cudaFree(areas);
+        cudaFree(rho);
+        cudaFree(kij);
+        cudaFree(tau);
+        cudaFree(radB);
+        cudaFree(distances);
+        cudaFree(octreeNodes);
+        cudaFree(leafTriangleIndices);
+        triangles = nullptr;
+        areas = nullptr;
+        rho = nullptr;
+        kij = nullptr;
+        tau = nullptr;
+        radB = nullptr;
+        distances = nullptr;
+        octreeNodes = nullptr;
+        leafTriangleIndices = nullptr;
+    }
+
+    ~DeviceState() { release(); }
+
+    void initialize(const std::vector<Triangle>& hostTriangles,
+                    const std::vector<val_t>& hostAreas,
+                    const std::vector<val_t>& hostRho,
+                    const std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& hostNodes,
+                    const std::vector<idx_t>& hostLeafIndices,
+                    size_t timesteps) {
+        numTriangles = hostTriangles.size();
+        numTimesteps = timesteps;
+        octreeNodeCount = static_cast<int>(hostNodes.size());
+
+        const size_t matrixElements = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+        const size_t radiosityElements = numTimesteps * numTriangles;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&triangles),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&areas), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&rho), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&kij), matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&tau), matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&radB), radiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&distances), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&octreeNodes),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&leafTriangleIndices),
+                              hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(idx_t)));
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(triangles, hostTriangles.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(areas, hostAreas.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(rho, hostRho.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(octreeNodes, hostNodes.data(),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(leafTriangleIndices, hostLeafIndices.data(),
+                              hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(idx_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(kij, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(tau, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(radB, 0, radiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(distances, 0, numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+
+    void copyKijToHost(std::vector<val_t>& hostKij) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostKij.data(), kij,
+                              hostKij.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    void copyTauToHost(std::vector<int>& hostTau) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostTau.data(), tau,
+                              hostTau.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;

+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n",
+                     file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}
+

+        distances = nullptr;
+        octreeNodes = nullptr;

+    }
+
+    ~DeviceState() { release(); }
+
+    void initialize(const std::vector<Triangle>& hostTriangles,

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&tau), matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&radB), radiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&distances), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&octreeNodes),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&leafTriangleIndices),
+                              hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(idx_t)));
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(triangles, hostTriangles.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(areas, hostAreas.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(rho, hostRho.data(),

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(leafTriangleIndices, hostLeafIndices.data(),

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(kij, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(tau, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(radB, 0, radiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(distances, 0, numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+
+    void copyKijToHost(std::vector<val_t>& hostKij) const {

// ============================================================================
// Mesh Generation: Icosphere
// ============================================================================

// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron
class IcosphereMesh {
public:
    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;

    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {
        // Initial icosahedron vertices
        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;

        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {
            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius
        };

        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)
        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {
            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},
            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},
            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},
            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}
        };

        // Subdivide
        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {
            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;
            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;

            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {
                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));
                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);
                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;

                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;
                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;
                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());
                vertices.push_back(mid);
                midpointCache[key] = idx;
                return idx;
            };

            for (const auto& face : faces) {
                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);
                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);
                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);

                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});
                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});
                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});
                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});
            }
            faces = std::move(newFaces);
        }

        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a "room")
        triangles.reserve(faces.size());
        for (const auto& face : faces) {
            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward
            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);
        }
    }
};

// ============================================================================
// Random Number Generation
// ============================================================================

class RandomGenerator {
    std::mt19937 rng;
    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;
public:
    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}
    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }
};

// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates
Vec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {
    val_t u = rng.rand();
    val_t v = rng.rand();
    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
        u = 1.0f - u;
        v = 1.0f - v;
    }
    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;
    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;
    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;
}

// ============================================================================
// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)
// ============================================================================

val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,
                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {
    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;
    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;
    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);

    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();

    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;
    size_t sourceIndex;
    bool copyValidationData = false;

    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }
    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }
};

// ============================================================================
// Initialization
// ============================================================================

void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,
                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {
    // Generate mesh
    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units
    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);
    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();
    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;
    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;

    printf("Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles);

    // Build octree for spatial acceleration
    printf("Building octree...\n");
    state.octree.build(state.triangles);

    std::vector<FlatOctreeNode> flatOctreeNodes;
    std::vector<idx_t> flatTriangleIndices;
    state.octree.flatten(flatOctreeNodes, flatTriangleIndices);

    // Initialize areas
    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();
    }

    // Initialize reflectivity
    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);

    // Initialize matrices
    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);
    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);

    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)
    size_t timeOn = 0;
    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;
    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {
        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;
    }

    // Allocate the persistent device scene once.  All subsequent numerical
    // phases operate on these resident buffers; only final arrays are copied
    // back to the host for validation and result reporting.
    state.device = std::make_unique<DeviceState>();
    state.device->initialize(state.triangles, state.areas, state.rho,
                             flatOctreeNodes, flatTriangleIndices, timesteps);
}

// ============================================================================
// Precomputation Phase
// ============================================================================

void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Computing form factors (Kij) on CUDA...\n");
    size_t pairCount = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
    dim3 block(CUDA_THREADS);
    dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((pairCount + CUDA_THREADS - 1) / CUDA_THREADS));
    computeFormFactorsKernel<<<grid, block>>>(
        state.device->triangles, state.device->kij,
        state.device->octreeNodes, state.device->leafTriangleIndices,
        state.device->octreeNodeCount, static_cast<uint64_t>(state.numTriangles));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    if (state.copyValidationData) state.device->copyKijToHost(state.kij);
    printf("  CUDA form-factor kernel complete for %zu pairs\n", pairCount);
}

void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Computing time delays (Tau) on CUDA...\n");
    size_t pairCount = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
    dim3 block(CUDA_THREADS);
    dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((pairCount + CUDA_THREADS - 1) / CUDA_THREADS));
    computeTimeDelaysKernel<<<grid, block>>>(
        state.device->triangles, state.device->tau,
        static_cast<uint64_t>(state.numTriangles));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    if (state.copyValidationData) state.device->copyTauToHost(state.tau);
    printf("  CUDA time-delay kernel complete for %zu pairs\n", pairCount);
}

// ============================================================================
// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)
// ============================================================================

void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Running wave propagation simulation on CUDA...\n");

    // Timestep launches are intentionally ordered in the default stream.  A
    // timestep depends on earlier delayed radiosity values, while every
    // receiver within a timestep is independent and is reduced by one block.
    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
        runSimulationTimestepKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(state.numTriangles), CUDA_THREADS>>>(
            state.device->areas, state.device->rho, state.device->kij, state.device->tau,
            state.device->radB, static_cast<uint64_t>(state.numTriangles),
            static_cast<uint64_t>(t), static_cast<uint64_t>(state.numTimesteps),
            static_cast<uint64_t>(state.sourceIndex));
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {
            printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);
        }
    }
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    if (state.copyValidationData) state.device->copyRadBToHost(state.radB);
}

// ============================================================================
// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)
// ============================================================================

void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Computing distances via cross-correlation on CUDA...\n");
    computeDistancesKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(state.numTriangles), CUDA_THREADS>>>(
        state.device->radB, state.device->distances,
        static_cast<uint64_t>(state.numTriangles),
        static_cast<uint64_t>(state.numTimesteps),
        static_cast<uint64_t>(state.sourceIndex));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    state.device->copyDistancesToHost(state.distances);
}

// ============================================================================
// Validation
// ============================================================================

bool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {
    printf("\nValidation:\n");

    // Check that distances are non-negative
    bool allNonNegative = true;
    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
    val_t sumDist = ZERO;
    int nonZeroCount = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        val_t d = state.distances[i];
        if (d < 0) {
            allNonNegative = false;
            printf("  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\n", i, d);
        }
        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {
            printf("  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\n", i, d);
            return false;
        }
        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);
        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);
        sumDist += d;
        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;
    }

    printf("  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", minDist, maxDist);
    printf("  Average distance: %.4f\n", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));
    printf("  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\n", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);

    // Check source distance is zero or very small
    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];
    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {
        printf("  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\n", srcDist);
    }

    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)
    int receivedEnergy = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+constexpr int CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE = 64;

+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n",
+                     file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}
+
+struct DeviceState {
+    Triangle* triangles = nullptr;
+    val_t* areas = nullptr;
+    val_t* rho = nullptr;
+    val_t* kij = nullptr;
+    int* tau = nullptr;
+    val_t* radB = nullptr;
+    val_t* distances = nullptr;
+    FlatOctreeNode* octreeNodes = nullptr;
+    idx_t* leafTriangleIndices = nullptr;
+    int octreeNodeCount = 0;
+    size_t numTriangles = 0;
+    size_t numTimesteps = 0;
+
+    void release() {
+        cudaFree(triangles);
+        cudaFree(areas);
+        cudaFree(rho);
+        cudaFree(kij);
+        cudaFree(tau);
+        cudaFree(radB);
+        cudaFree(distances);
+        cudaFree(octreeNodes);
+        cudaFree(leafTriangleIndices);
+        triangles = nullptr;
+        areas = nullptr;
+        rho = nullptr;
+        kij = nullptr;
+        tau = nullptr;
+        radB = nullptr;
+        distances = nullptr;
+        octreeNodes = nullptr;
+        leafTriangleIndices = nullptr;
+    }
+
+    ~DeviceState() { release(); }
+
+    void initialize(const std::vector<Triangle>& hostTriangles,
+                    const std::vector<val_t>& hostAreas,
+                    const std::vector<val_t>& hostRho,
+                    const std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& hostNodes,
+                    const std::vector<idx_t>& hostLeafIndices,
+                    size_t timesteps) {
+        numTriangles = hostTriangles.size();
+        numTimesteps = timesteps;
+        octreeNodeCount = static_cast<int>(hostNodes.size());
+
+        const size_t matrixElements = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+        const size_t radiosityElements = numTimesteps * numTriangles;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&triangles),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&areas), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&rho), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&kij), matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&tau), matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&radB), radiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&distances), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&octreeNodes),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)));

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;

+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n",
+                     file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}
+

+    val_t* areas = nullptr;

+    size_t numTimesteps = 0;
+
+    void release() {

+        cudaFree(areas);
+        cudaFree(rho);
+        cudaFree(kij);
+        cudaFree(tau);
+        cudaFree(radB);

+        cudaFree(octreeNodes);
+        cudaFree(leafTriangleIndices);
+        triangles = nullptr;
+        areas = nullptr;
+        rho = nullptr;
+        kij = nullptr;
+        tau = nullptr;
+        radB = nullptr;
+        distances = nullptr;
+        octreeNodes = nullptr;
+        leafTriangleIndices = nullptr;
+    }
+
+    ~DeviceState() { release(); }
+
+    void initialize(const std::vector<Triangle>& hostTriangles,
+                    const std::vector<val_t>& hostAreas,
+                    const std::vector<val_t>& hostRho,
+                    const std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& hostNodes,
+                    const std::vector<idx_t>& hostLeafIndices,
+                    size_t timesteps) {
+        numTriangles = hostTriangles.size();
+        numTimesteps = timesteps;
+        octreeNodeCount = static_cast<int>(hostNodes.size());
+
+        const size_t matrixElements = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+        const size_t radiosityElements = numTimesteps * numTriangles;
+        const size_t allocatedRadiosityElements = std::max<size_t>(1, radiosityElements);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&triangles),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&areas), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&rho), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&kij), matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&tau), matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&radB),
+                              allocatedRadiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&distances), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&octreeNodes),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&leafTriangleIndices),
+                              hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(idx_t)));
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(triangles, hostTriangles.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(areas, hostAreas.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(rho, hostRho.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(octreeNodes, hostNodes.data(),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(leafTriangleIndices, hostLeafIndices.data(),
+                              hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(idx_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(kij, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(tau, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(radB, 0, allocatedRadiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(distances, 0, numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+
+    void copyKijToHost(std::vector<val_t>& hostKij) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostKij.data(), kij,
+                              hostKij.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    void copyTauToHost(std::vector<int>& hostTau) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostTau.data(), tau,
+                              hostTau.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }

+                              hostDistances.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }

+    int32_t flattenNode(std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& flatNodes,
+                        std::vector<idx_t>& flatTriangleIndices) const {
+        const int32_t nodeIndex = static_cast<int32_t>(flatNodes.size());
+        FlatOctreeNode flat{};

+            }
+        }
+        return nodeIndex;

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+constexpr int CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE = 64;

+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n",
+                     file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}

+    Vec3 halfExtent;

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+constexpr int CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE = 64;
+
+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n",
+                     file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) cudaCheck((expression), #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__)
