+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}
+
+struct DeviceState {

+    val_t* areas = nullptr;
+    val_t* rho = nullptr;

+    size_t numTriangles = 0;
+    size_t numTimesteps = 0;
+
+    void release() {
+        cudaFree(triangles);
+        cudaFree(areas);
+        cudaFree(rho);
+        cudaFree(kij);
+        cudaFree(tau);
+        cudaFree(radB);
+        cudaFree(distances);
+        cudaFree(octreeNodes);
+        cudaFree(leafTriangleIndices);
+        triangles = nullptr;
+        areas = nullptr;
+        rho = nullptr;
+        kij = nullptr;
+        tau = nullptr;
+        radB = nullptr;
+        distances = nullptr;
+        octreeNodes = nullptr;
+        leafTriangleIndices = nullptr;
+    }
+
+    ~DeviceState() { release(); }
+
+    void initialize(const std::vector<Triangle>& hostTriangles,
+                    const std::vector<val_t>& hostAreas,
+                    const std::vector<val_t>& hostRho,
+                    const std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& hostNodes,
+                    const std::vector<idx_t>& hostLeafIndices,
+                    size_t timesteps) {
+        numTriangles = hostTriangles.size();
+        numTimesteps = timesteps;
+        octreeNodeCount = static_cast<int>(hostNodes.size());
+
+        const size_t matrixElements = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+        const size_t radiosityElements = numTimesteps * numTriangles;
+        const size_t allocatedRadiosityElements = std::max<size_t>(1, radiosityElements);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&triangles),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&areas), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&rho), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&kij), matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&tau), matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&radB),
+                              allocatedRadiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&distances), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&octreeNodes),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&leafTriangleIndices),
+                              hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(idx_t)));
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(triangles, hostTriangles.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(areas, hostAreas.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(rho, hostRho.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(octreeNodes, hostNodes.data(),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(leafTriangleIndices, hostLeafIndices.data(),
+                              hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(idx_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(kij, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(tau, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(radB, 0, allocatedRadiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(distances, 0, numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+
+    void copyKijToHost(std::vector<val_t>& hostKij) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostKij.data(), kij,
+                              hostKij.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    void copyTauToHost(std::vector<int>& hostTau) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostTau.data(), tau,
+                              hostTau.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    void copyRadBToHost(std::vector<val_t>& hostRadB) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostRadB.data(), radB,
+                              hostRadB.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }

+    void copyDistancesToHost(std::vector<val_t>& hostDistances) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostDistances.data(), distances,
+                              hostDistances.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }

+    int32_t flattenNode(std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& flatNodes,
+                        std::vector<idx_t>& flatTriangleIndices) const {
+        const int32_t nodeIndex = static_cast<int32_t>(flatNodes.size());
+        FlatOctreeNode flat{};
+        flat.center = center;
+        flat.halfExtent = halfExtent;
+        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) flat.children[i] = -1;
+        flat.triangleStart = static_cast<uint32_t>(flatTriangleIndices.size());
+        flat.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {
+            flatTriangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<idx_t>(idx));
+        }
+        flatNodes.push_back(flat);

+        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+            if (children[i]) {
+                flatNodes[nodeIndex].children[i] =
+                    children[i]->flattenNode(flatNodes, flatTriangleIndices);
+            }
+        }
+        return nodeIndex;
+    }

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+constexpr int CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE = 64;

+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n",
+                     file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+constexpr int CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE = 64;
+
+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n",
+                     file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) cudaCheck((expression), #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__)

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}
+

+// CUDA implementation
+// ============================================================================
+
+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+constexpr int CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE = 64;
+
+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n",
+                     file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) cudaCheck((expression), #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__)
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}

+struct DeviceState {
+    Triangle* triangles = nullptr;
+    val_t* areas = nullptr;
+    val_t* rho = nullptr;
+    val_t* kij = nullptr;
+    int* tau = nullptr;
+    val_t* radB = nullptr;
+    val_t* distances = nullptr;
+    FlatOctreeNode* octreeNodes = nullptr;
+    idx_t* leafTriangleIndices = nullptr;
+    int octreeNodeCount = 0;
+    size_t numTriangles = 0;
+    size_t numTimesteps = 0;
+
+    void release() {
+        cudaFree(triangles);
+        cudaFree(areas);
+        cudaFree(rho);
+        cudaFree(kij);
+        cudaFree(tau);
+        cudaFree(radB);
+        cudaFree(distances);
+        cudaFree(octreeNodes);
+        cudaFree(leafTriangleIndices);
+        triangles = nullptr;
+        areas = nullptr;
+        rho = nullptr;
+        kij = nullptr;
+        tau = nullptr;
+        radB = nullptr;
+        distances = nullptr;
+        octreeNodes = nullptr;
+        leafTriangleIndices = nullptr;
+    }
+
+    ~DeviceState() { release(); }
+
+    void initialize(const std::vector<Triangle>& hostTriangles,
+                    const std::vector<val_t>& hostAreas,
+                    const std::vector<val_t>& hostRho,
+                    const std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& hostNodes,
+                    const std::vector<idx_t>& hostLeafIndices,
+                    size_t timesteps) {
+        numTriangles = hostTriangles.size();
+        numTimesteps = timesteps;
+        octreeNodeCount = static_cast<int>(hostNodes.size());
+
+        const size_t matrixElements = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+        const size_t radiosityElements = numTimesteps * numTriangles;
+        const size_t allocatedRadiosityElements = std::max<size_t>(1, radiosityElements);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&triangles),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&areas), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&rho), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&kij), matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&tau), matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&radB),
+                              allocatedRadiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&distances), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&octreeNodes),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&leafTriangleIndices),
+                              hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(idx_t)));
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(triangles, hostTriangles.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(areas, hostAreas.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(rho, hostRho.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(octreeNodes, hostNodes.data(),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(leafTriangleIndices, hostLeafIndices.data(),
+                              hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(idx_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(kij, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(tau, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(radB, 0, allocatedRadiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(distances, 0, numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+
+    void copyKijToHost(std::vector<val_t>& hostKij) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostKij.data(), kij,
+                              hostKij.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    void copyTauToHost(std::vector<int>& hostTau) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostTau.data(), tau,
+                              hostTau.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    void copyRadBToHost(std::vector<val_t>& hostRadB) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostRadB.data(), radB,
+                              hostRadB.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    void copyDistancesToHost(std::vector<val_t>& hostDistances) const {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostDistances.data(), distances,
+                              hostDistances.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+};

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;

+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n",
+                     file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) cudaCheck((expression), #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__)

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}
+

+        areas = nullptr;

+        tau = nullptr;
+        radB = nullptr;
+        distances = nullptr;
+        octreeNodes = nullptr;

+    }
+
+    ~DeviceState() { release(); }
+
+    void initialize(const std::vector<Triangle>& hostTriangles,

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&kij), matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&tau), matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&radB),
+                              allocatedRadiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&distances), numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&octreeNodes),
+                              hostNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&leafTriangleIndices),
+                              hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(idx_t)));

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(areas, hostAreas.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(rho, hostRho.data(),
+                              numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(leafTriangleIndices, hostLeafIndices.data(),

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(kij, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(tau, 0, matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(radB, 0, allocatedRadiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(distances, 0, numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+
+    void copyKijToHost(std::vector<val_t>& hostKij) const {

+    int32_t flattenNode(std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& flatNodes,
+                        std::vector<idx_t>& flatTriangleIndices) const {
+        const int32_t nodeIndex = static_cast<int32_t>(flatNodes.size());
+        FlatOctreeNode flat{};
+        flat.center = center;
+        flat.halfExtent = halfExtent;
+        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) flat.children[i] = -1;
+        flat.triangleStart = static_cast<uint32_t>(flatTriangleIndices.size());
+        flat.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {
+            flatTriangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<idx_t>(idx));
+        }
+        flatNodes.push_back(flat);
+
+        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+            if (children[i]) {
+                flatNodes[nodeIndex].children[i] =
+                    children[i]->flattenNode(flatNodes, flatTriangleIndices);
+            }
+        }
+        return nodeIndex;
+    }

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+constexpr int CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE = 64;

+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n",
+                     file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+    const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+    const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+// The flattened tree is traversed in the same child order as the original
+// recursive octree.  A fixed local stack avoids recursion and keeps all ray
+// visibility work on the GPU.
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(
+    const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, idx_t sourceTriangle, idx_t destinationTriangle) {
+    Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = direction.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    int stack[CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                idx_t triangleIndex = leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + k];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        // Push in reverse so the next pop visits children 0..7, matching the
+        // host octree traversal order.
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                if (stackSize < CUDA_RAY_STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    // Stateless SplitMix64-derived samples give every (pair, ray, coordinate)
+    // an independent deterministic value without a serialized RNG state.
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandom01(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sample) {
+    uint64_t key = pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL + sample;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(key) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 deviceRandomPointInTriangle(
+    const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t ray) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 0);
+    val_t v = deviceRandom01(pairIndex, ray * 4 + 1);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceCosPhi(const Vec3& vector, const Vec3& normal) {
+    val_t vectorNorm = vector.norm();
+    if (vectorNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
+    return fmaxf(ZERO, vector.dot(normal) / vectorNorm);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceComputeKij(
+    uint64_t idxI, uint64_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,
+    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices,
+    int nodeCount, uint64_t pairIndex) {
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[idxI];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[idxJ];
+
+    if (triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pointI = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleI, pairIndex, ray);
+        Vec3 pointJ = deviceRandomPointInTriangle(triangleJ, pairIndex, ray + NUM_RAYS);
+
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices,
+                             nodeCount, static_cast<idx_t>(idxI), static_cast<idx_t>(idxJ))) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        Vec3 vector = pointJ - pointI;
+        val_t distanceSquared = vector.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        val_t cosPhiI = deviceCosPhi(vector, triangleI.normal());
+        val_t cosPhiJ = deviceCosPhi(-vector, triangleJ.normal());
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, int* tau, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(delta.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+    const Triangle* triangles, val_t* kij, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+    const idx_t* leafTriangleIndices, int nodeCount, uint64_t numTriangles) {
+    uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    uint64_t pairCount = numTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+
+    uint64_t i = pairIndex / numTriangles;
+    uint64_t j = pairIndex - i * numTriangles;
+    kij[pairIndex] = (i == j) ? ZERO : deviceComputeKij(
+        i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices, nodeCount, pairIndex);
+}
+
+__global__ void runSimulationTimestepKernel(
+    const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+    val_t* radB, uint64_t numTriangles, uint64_t timestep,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partial[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    for (uint64_t j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        uint64_t matrixIndex = i * numTriangles + j;
+        int tauIJ = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < tauIJ) continue;
+
+        val_t formFactor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        uint64_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<uint64_t>(tauIJ);
+        val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        val_t emission = (timestep < numTimesteps / 2 && i == sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[timestep * numTriangles + i] = rho[i] * partial[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+    const val_t* radB, val_t* distances, uint64_t numTriangles,
+    uint64_t numTimesteps, uint64_t sourceIndex) {
+    uint64_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestCorrelation[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int bestTime[CUDA_THREADS];
+    val_t localMax = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+
+    for (uint64_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint64_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {
+            val_t radiosityB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];
+            val_t radiositySource = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+            sum += radiositySource * radiosityB;
+        }
+        if (sum > localMax) {
+            localMax = sum;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(t);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = localMax;
+    bestTime[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = CUDA_THREADS / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t otherCorrelation = bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            int otherTime = bestTime[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < bestTime[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestCorrelation[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                bestTime[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime[0]);
+}
